claims.claim: Added the exact content-bound moa-1 v1 profile for REMEDIATION_AUTHORING with two bounded, remediation-specific passes and one final closure.

MOA binds supplied RUN, REVIEW, finding, reviewed SHA, TASK authority and correction provenance. Missing or conflicting decisive sources force UNKNOWN blockers without authenticating sources through hashes or model declarations.
Final UNIQUE_FINDING proposals require construct and adversarial challenge passes and preserve the selected finding, action, reviewed SHA, original scope, constraints and permitted verification.
CORRECTION_FRONTIER supports bounded analysis of its exact outstanding set while forbidding draft or final remediation candidates and implicit target selection.

The second pass requires concrete counterexamples, bound references, explicit dispositions and one consistent closure. Profile instructions and validation address source substitution, scope interference, unsupported cause, action mismatch, stale authority and mixed or duplicate audits.

MOA requires explicit isolated conformance modes. Historical profile content and replay paths remain intact; production policy, direct correction ingress, Human A3 and downstream authorities were not modified.

Authored focused positive and adversarial tests for unique/frontier subjects, bounds, malformed sources, currentness, reconciliation, duplicate audits and both transports while retaining historical and ROA regressions.
